items.title: Your tests passed. Your app didn't.
items.summary: Error definitions catch crash dialogs, "Session expired" and other error screens that no step checked for. List the messages in one CSV file, and Optics looks for them on the last screen of every run.
items.author: Chinmay Jha
items.alt: The headline Your tests passed. Your app didn't. beside a phone showing a Session expired dialog and a run that passed with an on-screen error

items.title: Introducing Optics: create a test your way, run it forever
items.summary: Optics is an open-source test automation framework for Android, iOS, web and TV apps. Tests are CSV or YAML files, and each element on screen can have several locators.
items.author: Chinmay Jha
items.alt: The headline Create it your way. Run it forever. beside a modules.csv test file and a passing optics execute run
